subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Comical
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Comical"** means something that is funny or amusing; it is often used to describe situations, actions, or people **that cause laughter.** (हास्यपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **The comical antics of the clown had everyone in stitches.
 
 
 
• **"Tragic"** refers to something that is very sad, often involving death or suffering; it is the opposite of comical. (दुखद)
 
 
• **Example: **The **tragic** story of the young hero brought tears to everyone's eyes.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Comical'** is **'Tragic'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Remedial **(उपचारात्मक): Intended to correct or improve something, often used in the context of education or health.

 
 
• **Example:** The** remedial **classes helped the student catch up with the rest of the class.
 
 
 
• **Rebellious **(विद्रोही): Showing a desire to resist authority, control, or convention.
 
 
• **Example: **The** rebellious** teenager refused to follow school rules.
 
 
 
• **Farcical **(हास्यास्पद): Relating to or resembling a farce; ludicrously absurd.
 
 
• **Example:** The **farcical** situation in the courtroom left everyone confused and amused.
